verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents paying x402 and MPP endpoints and using Visa/Mastercard agent rails, but nothing in the evidence shows that any of these protocols, or Crossmint's own APIs, is published as an open, versioned specification a developer can read and implement without an agreement. Its own surface is a proprietary REST API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Supporting a third-party protocol is not evidence that the protocol's spec is open and versioned.

support.subject: As a developer, the commerce protocol this product speaks is published as an open, versioned specification I can read and implement without signing anything
